# 1000 Strangers

> A free short film and website encouraging people in Ireland (north and south) to adopt or foster rescue animals. Not tied to any one shelter or charity.

## Pages
- [Home](https://1000strangers.com/): the film and the campaign
- [The numbers](https://1000strangers.com/numbers/): dogs entering Irish council pounds each year, outcomes, and who pays for rescue
- [Adopt](https://1000strangers.com/adopt/): how adopting from an Irish rescue works, fostering, volunteering, common myths
- [Shelters](https://1000strangers.com/shelters/): directory of 141 rescues, shelters and council pounds across all 32 counties, with donate links and cruelty helplines
- [Lost and found](https://1000strangers.com/lost-found/): what to do if you lose or find a pet in Ireland
- [About](https://1000strangers.com/about/): who made the film and how rescues can use it
